_comment: Remotely-updatable eBay selector config for the GradeThread Condition Check extension (US-1755). The extension bundles a copy of this (extension-condition/selectors.js) and fetches this hosted file to pick up selector fixes WITHOUT a Chrome Web Store / AMO resubmission. When eBay changes its listing DOM: fix the selectors below, bump version + lastVerified, and deploy the frontend. Served statically by Cloudflare Pages (not in _routes.json include). Shape must match extension-condition/selectors.js GT_CC_SELECTORS.
